parts.text: I worry about instruction links to drones and charging equipment being unreliable, where an instruction might get through twice and the sender cannot tell if the first attempt arrived. I also worry about radio coverage being patchy around ports, industrial sites, and in bad weather, causing reports from drones to arrive late, out of order, more than once, or not at all. Additionally, it worries me that the service runs on a single server that is updated and restarted during working hours and occasionally crashes, accepting a few minutes of interruption.
